site.title: AI Model Recommender
site.tagline: Pick the right AI model without the buzzwords.
home.hero.title: Find the AI model that fits your work — and your wallet.
home.hero.lede: We track every public AI model, every major benchmark, every provider, and we explain what it means in plain language. Then we tell you which one to use.
home.section.learn.title: Learn the basics
home.section.learn.body: Tokens, context windows, quantization, licenses — we demystify the terms so you can choose with confidence.
home.section.track.title: Up to date, automatically
home.section.track.body: We sync daily from public sources (models.dev, LiteLLM, Artificial Analysis) and notify you when a model changes.
home.section.compare.title: Side by side
home.section.compare.body: Pick the candidates, see the benchmarks, choose. No login required.
status.title: Pipeline status
compare.title: Compare models side by side
compare.lede: Pick 2 to 4 models and see their prices, context windows, capabilities, and benchmarks in one table.
compare.empty_body: Add models from the catalog, or search above to start comparing.
compare.max_4: You can compare at most 4 models at once. Remove one to add another.
